text:
Alex P: Quick sync — week 1 after GA. Need to triage the backlog for the streaming responses rollout: separate actionable bugs from nice-to-have enhancements. My rough rule: Sev1/2 -> hotfix lane, any regression impacting >5% sessions -> immediate patch, everything else -> Sprint 2. Thoughts?

Maya R: +1 to the heat-lane. Quick note: I reproduced truncated stream when client reconnects with same convo id — will paste logs.
Maya R: ```
request id: req-9a3f
client reconnect -> stream closed early at token 87
server side showed kv-cache miss during reconnection
```

Jon S: Thanks — that matches an SRE alert we saw overnight. I created RI-2345 and flagged as Sev2: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-2345. Looks like it only surfaces for long-running sessions (>60s).

Sam K: Support is seeing a spike in customers asking for deterministic rerun of streams when their client drops. They're asking for either a retry button or clearer client guidance. Not all are urgent, but a few enterprise customers are blocked.

Elena V: Suggestion: schedule a 30-min async grooming tomorrow. We can slot 3 x quick fixes into a hotfix bundle (aim for next 48h) and then scope 4 enhancements for Sprint 2. Also propose a small telemetry task to capture reconnection patterns (low effort, immediate signal).

Alex P: Proposed hotfix candidates (from backlog + triage):
- RI-2345 truncated reconnection (Sev2)
- RI-2380 malformed JSON edge for streaming partials (Sev2)
- RI-2401 client backpressure deadlock (Sev1)
If we agree, I'll ask eng to do canary for the bundle.

Maya R: OK on the list. For RI-2345 I have a short patch ready (KV cache guard) — can land as part of the bundle.

Jon S: Canary window: I'll open us-west for 2 hours tonight and monitor traces. deploy-bot: kick off canary?

deploy-bot: Canary deploy initiated: bundle-hotfix-2026-03-21 -> us-west. Status: in-progress. (logs will post in #eng-releases)

Sam K: For communications: I'll prepare a status blurb for affected customers if the canary goes green. If not, we'll revert and communicate ETA for fix.

Elena V: Action items: Alex to prioritize tickets, Maya to attach PRs to the hotfix bundle, Jon to run canary, Sam to prep customer note, product to add telemetry card to the backlog for Sprint 2.

Alex P: I'll also add a lightweight acceptance checklist for hotfixes: reproduce, unit test, trace for 95th pct latency, and smoke test multi-tenant streams. If everyone ok, I'll mark the three tickets as hotfix and ping eng-oncall.

Maya R: ok, ping me when deployed. I'll watch for truncated stream errors.

Jon S: Canary healthy after 90m. No new truncation alerts in the window. Marking as pass for now, continuing monitoring.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy completed: bundle-hotfix-2026-03-21 -> us-west. Status: success.

Alex P: Great — marking the bundle as shipped to canary. Sam, can you send the customer note saying we deployed a canary fix and are monitoring? Use: "We deployed a canary fix addressing intermittent truncated streams; if you still see issues please reply with session IDs"

Sam K: Will do. Drafting now.

Elena V: I'll create the Sprint 2 card titled "Streaming follow-ons: reconnection telemetry + UX retry affordance + backpressure docs" and link the enhancement tickets.

Alex P: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene in 48h unless something pops. :thumbsup:
